guide sentence: Seeing the change, finding your place in Jackson Ward, 1952 and today
A pocket guide to Jackson Ward in Richmond, Virginia, with every street named on maps and drawings of 1952 and today, and ten places to stand and look.

A pocket guide to Jackson Ward in Richmond, Virginia, for finding your place in 1952 and today, with plan maps that name every street, a street index with grid squares, drawings of 1952 and today with the streets named on them, and ten places to stand and look, drawn from the published Jackson Ward story.
Seeing the change: finding your place in Jackson Ward, 1952 and today
How to use this guide
Find a street you know in the street index or on the maps.
Its grid square, such as C4, is the same on every map.
The drawings show the same blocks in 1952 and today, seen from the south, with the streets named in both.
The ten places to stand are on public sidewalks, numbered west to east only so you can find them; go to any of them, in any order.
